name: Tiny Vinyard
detailed_description:
A first-person, 2D "theater-view" wine-brewing rhythm game where players step into the shoes of a passionate homebrew winemaker in the heart of France. Experience the beauty of terroir as you select grapes, master winemaking techniques, and create unique blends that reflect your personal style. Each step of the winemaking process is illustrated, with your choices and scores impacting the final product. Sometimes delightfully, sometimes less so! Enjoy a calming atmosphere with unique hand painted visuals, enriched by soothing music and satisfying sound effects.

Once you’ve perfected your creation, share your handcrafted, custom-decorated bottle with friends via email or text, inviting them to admire the fruits of your labor.

With a tongue-in-cheek twist on oenology, this game playfully pokes fun at the lofty airs of wine appreciation, dismantling the mystique of wine elitism. Players explore “refined” tastes, “complex” aromas, and “exclusive” vocabulary in a setting where humor meets high-brow.
